candidate.educational_objective: Teach a layered UV-protection strategy using shade, protective clothing, and broad-spectrum water-resistant SPF 30+ sunscreen with appropriate reapplication.

options.A: Use SPF 15 sunscreen alone and skip shade or protective clothing because sunscreen replaces other sun-protection measures.
options.B: Use broad-spectrum, water-resistant SPF 30 or higher on exposed skin, seek shade, wear sun-protective clothing, and reapply sunscreen as directed when outdoors.
options.C: Use sunscreen only on days that include swimming because ordinary outdoor activity does not require routine sun protection.
options.D: Apply sunscreen once in the morning and do not reapply during prolonged outdoor activity.

candidate.rationale: American Academy of Dermatology guidance recommends broad-spectrum, water-resistant sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher, plus shade and sun-protective clothing. It also advises reapplying sunscreen during ongoing outdoor exposure, including after swimming or sweating. B is the only option that reflects the layered strategy.
